capabilities: Transcribe real-time microphone input or vault audio files into Markdown transcript files
Run configurable AI analysis templates on transcripts and write structured results back
Extract, review, and compile evidence-backed candidate memories into managed profiles
Automate transcription of new audio links and newly created audio files
Configure cloud and local transcription, analysis, and memory providers with local checks
extras: Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Sends audio and transcript text to external cloud services whenever transcription, analysis, or memory extraction runs; the README includes an explicit privacy notice and per-provider data-use details. Real-time transcription requires Obsidian desktop with a local filesystem vault. Documentation is heavily oriented toward Chinese-language providers and workflows; contact is via WeChat.
motivation: The author built it because generic transcription tools produce one output for all scenarios, and because meeting content kept outside Obsidian loses context and never enters the existing knowledge workflow.
problem: Transcription and meeting-minutes products keep output in separate platforms, so recordings, transcripts, and action items stay disconnected from the vault's daily notes, projects, and knowledge workflow.

relations.evidence: Real-time mode continuously sends microphone PCM to Volcengine AgentPlan.
Alibaba Bailian qwen3-asr-flash: local files are encoded as Base64 Data URLs.
SiliconFlow: each request must stay within both 50 MB and one hour.
MOSI with selectable moss-transcribe plain transcription or moss-transcribe-diarize speaker diarization
Ollama through its local OpenAI-compatible /audio/transcriptions endpoint
LM Studio through its local OpenAI-compatible /audio/transcriptions endpoint
OpenAI analysis uploads the transcript text and template instructions using your separate analysis API key.
Obsidian's Audio recorder core plugin is used only by the offline workflow: it saves a complete recording after stop

requires.name: Transcription, analysis, or memory provider API key (Volcengine AgentPlan, Alibaba Bailian, SiliconFlow, MOSI, OpenAI, DeepSeek, OpenCode Go)

summary: Audio transcription plugin that converts recordings into Markdown transcripts, applies configurable AI analysis templates, and optionally builds a reviewed personal memory system.
